statements.status_notes: The fix requires joi 18.2.1 or newer, which is a major version bump from the current 17.13.3. Joi is pulled in transitively via node-radius-client and is used for schema validation of RADIUS authentication configuration. The CVE (GHSA-5v2h-r2cx-5xgj) involves a prototype pollution vulnerability that requires attacker-controlled validation schema input. In Uptime Kuma, joi validates RADIUS configuration provided by authenticated administrators rather than anonymous attacker-controlled input. The risk of breaking changes from a major version bump (17.x to 18.x) is being evaluated against the actual exploitability in this context. A non-breaking remediation path is under assessment.
